name: Plume Bundle
description: Green, teal, blue and red plumes on a pale cord. Emberwing-gaudy, and whatever wore them is no longer loud.

source.prompt: Item drops from enemies in an MMORPG. I want mostly stuff you sell in the store for gold. No equipment or weapons. This is usually stuff the enemy is made of, parts of their body or cloths, but it can be anything really. Use your fantasy. I want variety.
